learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected about one run in four for one swap each way; locked it in. Toy groups50 each,half red,colour pure chance,200 generations.
observations.exploration: Alone produced100 of200 runs50% over half apart. One swap produced4 of200,2%. Five swaps produced1 of200,0.5%. Reveal unlocked after alone/one contrast.
observations.reveal: Cites all three observed counts. Explains chance drives groups toward one colour while newcomers bring other colour back. Ends broad statement about one migrant per generation stopping small groups drifting apart.
observations.visual: Inline initial/one-swap screenshots inspected. Square scatter plot of red share in two groups,shaded corners denote over-half difference; few red dots in corners under one swap,green dots mostly nearer diagonal. Axis labels lack numeric ticks. Trust4/4 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884122 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.
